# Logseq SDK source

Copied from `libs/src` in Logseq release 2.0.2, commit `533ac4382a7b69baa98de3a973bff90305b212dc`: https://github.com/logseq/logseq/tree/533ac4382a7b69baa98de3a973bff90305b212dc/libs/src. The upstream repository is distributed under AGPL-3.0. The plugin builds this source with updated DOMPurify and lodash-es dependencies; the SDK's npm package contains a prebuilt bundle with older versions.
